cases.description: When the concrete validator sets the protected `keyword` field to a Keyword instance whose value is "type", `getKeyword()` should return the exact string "type".
When the concrete validator sets the protected `keyword` field to a Keyword instance whose value is "minimum", `getKeyword()` should return "minimum".
When the concrete validator sets the protected `keyword` field to a Keyword instance whose value is "pattern", `getKeyword()` should return "pattern".
When the concrete validator sets `keyword` to a Keyword whose value is an empty string, `getKeyword()` should return the empty string.
When `keyword` contains only whitespace characters, `getKeyword()` should return the exact whitespace string.
When the concrete validator sets `keyword` to a very long string (e.g., 1000 characters), `getKeyword()` should return the full string without truncation.
